name: ZRL 2026/27 R1 W6: Spiral Summit (points race)
notes: km = race distance from the start, as in Zwift Insider's guide. A new route made for ZRL: the route name is the guide's, check it against Zwift's on the day. FAL and FTS on all six segments; the Volcano KOM's FAL counts as finish points. The guide gives no km for the Volcano's parts; the final item's km is its length (3.8 km) less the final 400 m.

items.name: Start pens
items.info: burrito for everyone: no draft in a cone behind you for 20 s

items.name: Jarvis Lap
items.info: a lap segment: FAL at its end (14.9 km), FTS over the lap; holds the first Jarvis KOM and Sprint

items.name: Jarvis KOM (1st)
items.info: two parts: ~1 km push, 500 m flat or down, then a 300 m push; expect a big push, the dropped stay dropped

items.name: Jarvis Sprint (1st)
items.info: at high speed off the descent after the KOM

items.name: Jarvis KOM (2nd)
items.info: the same climb; the guide expects it ridden slowly, saving for the Volcano

items.name: Volcano KOM
items.info: the finish: 1.3 km at 4-5% with short dips, 500 m flat, 1 km climb, 500 m climb, then 400 m flattish kicking to 10%; aero beats light, hold a wheel

items.name: Finish: the last 400 m of the Volcano
items.info: flattish, kicking up to 10% at the line
